concept.title: Purpose
concept.shortdesc: This guide provides mandatory best practices for anyone who creates or prepares HTML source content

conbody.p: This guide provides mandatory best practices for anyone who creates or prepares HTML source content for conversion to DITA-XML using the metR DocMigration HTML to DITA converter. The converter is a modular microservice with an embedded AI Agent that reasons and enriches DITA elements in document structure before transforming them into standards-compliant DITA-XML.

ul.li: The converter correctly identifies topic boundaries, heading hierarchies, and content types.
The AI Conversion Agent classifies topics accurately as concept, task, reference, or troubleshooting.
The generated DITA-XML output is clean and complete, requiring minimal post-conversion cleanup.
Metadata and Ditamap hierarchies are detected reliably.
